title: Attack & Decay
concept:
The first two stages of the ADSR envelope shape the beginning of a note.

Attack is the time from key press to peak level. A very short attack (near 0 s) gives an instant, punchy start — percussive sounds like drums and plucked strings have short attacks. A long attack (1–3 s) creates a slow swell, like a string section fading in or a pad that breathes.

Decay is the time from peak level down to the Sustain level. A short decay with a low sustain gives a note that punches and immediately drops — the basis of many bass and lead sounds. A long decay blends the peak smoothly into the held note.

The patch starts with a very short attack. Change the Attack to 1.5 seconds and hear the note bloom in slowly rather than starting instantly.

task.instruction: Set the ADSR's Attack to 1.5 s. Raise the Attack knob on the ADSR Envelope component, then press a key and hear the note swell in slowly.
